text:
ops-bot: S2 incident (api-gateway) has been stabilized and routing fallback is live. Customers impacted: multiple 502 errors for ~18 mins, main hit on eu-west-1. PagerDF: INC-2026-042. Can we schedule an after-action / PIR within the next 48 hrs to capture timeline and action items? :calendar:
Maya R: I can facilitate if folks want. Free window tomorrow 09:30-11:30 PT or afternoon 15:00-17:00 PT. Will prepare timeline pre-read.
Alex P: thanks. Can we get a quick customer-impact summary in the thread for pre-reads? Which tenants hit and any payment-sensitive customers?
ops-bot: Summary link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042/summary (contains affected tenants list, first-seen graphs, and initial mitigation steps). Top 3 affected customers: acme-inc, finch-saas, greenbox. No clear PII exfiltration.
Jen L: I can cover CS/customer comms notes. Prefer not before 10am PT. If Maya is facilitating, can I co-own action-item follow-ups?
Samir T: Happy to jump in as backup facilitator if Maya is busy. Also we should invite infra + payments on the call (Leo + payments eng).
Leo K: pls add infra-oncall and payments-eng to RSVP. Also we need logs from the edge LB for the 18:05-18:23 window — I'll take ownership of getting those and attach to the doc.
Nina S: For tracking, please add action items in the PIR tracker: https://redwood.internal/pir-tracker (use template "PIR - S2 - API Gateway"). I'll make the first row with owners/due dates after facilitator confirmed.
Alex P: I can't make the 09:30 slot. 16:00-16:30 PT would work for me. If we do multiple slots, pick one that gets most :thumbsup:.
incident-bot: PIR agenda template posted:
```
1) Timeline & primary mitigation (10m)
2) Customer impact summary (5m)
3) Root-cause hypotheses and evidence (15m)
4) Action items & owners (10m)
5) Rollout / regression guard checks (5m)
6) Follow-ups / verification plan (5m)
```
ops-bot: Proposed times (PT):
- Option A: Tomorrow 10:30-11:00 (Maya can do)
- Option B: Tomorrow 16:00-16:30 (Alex can do)
- Option C: Day after tomorrow 09:30-10:00
Please react with :white_check_mark: to your preferred option, or type a different window.
Maya R: I'm fine facilitating Option A or C. I'll draft the timeline pre-read in the incident page and ping owners for artifacts.
Samir T: If Maya ends up facilitating Option A, I'm happy to chair Option B in case of conflicts.
Jen L: I'll take notes/minutes for whichever slot we pick. Can someone add me to the calendar invite and annotate the agenda with CS impacts?
Leo K: Added infra-oncall (leo-infra) + payments-eng (shweta) to the suggested attendee list on the doc.
Nina S: Action-item starter: "collect edge LB logs (leo)" due EOD tomorrow, "confirm customer retry behavior (jen)" due +48h. I'll add these to the tracker after slot confirmed.
Alex P: Option B :white_check_mark: from me.
Maya R: Option A :white_check_mark: for me. Option B also ok if we need a later one.
Samir T: Option B :white_check_mark: (happy to step in if needed).
Jen L: Option B :white_check_mark: (prefer later).
ops-bot: Tally so far: Option A = 1, Option B = 3, Option C = 0. Leaning Option B (tomorrow 16:00-16:30 PT).
Maya R: OK let's lock Option B (tomorrow 16:00 PT). I can still facilitate if needed; Samir is backup. Jen will take notes.
incident-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood/internal/event?eid=INC-2026-042-PIR (tomorrow 16:00 PT, 30m). Pre-read and timeline added to incident page.
Jen L: I added CS talking points to the pre-read (section "Customer Impact - CS notes").
Leo K: I'll upload LB logs and a quick grep extract to the incident page by +6h.
Nina S: I'll create the initial action-items table now and assign temporary owners, we'll refine after the call.
Alex P: Quick question — do we want a follow-up verification window to re-check the fix in prod (smoke check)? If yes, add it as action item with owner and a runbook check.
Maya R: Yes, add "post-deploy smoke check (infra, leo)" with 24h cadence for 3 days. I'll write the verification steps in the doc.
Samir T: Also recommend we add a short change to the alerting thresholds to reduce noisy paging during partial backend failures. I'll draft the alert proposal.
ops-bot: Notes for facilitator: please populate at least timeline + suspected root causes section before the meeting. Use the template section "Facilitator checklist" on the incident page.
Maya R: Will do. Thanks everyone — I'll send final calendar update in ~30m and ping folks with the prep link. Please add any other pre-reads to the incident page. :thumbsup:
